patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Beehiiv is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Beehiiv is narrower/specialist.. Choose ActiveCampaign only if your buying job matches “Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+;” rather than Beehiiv's shape. Choose Beehiiv only if your buying job matches “Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referrals, and audience tool” rather than ActiveCampaign's shape. Workflow advantage: ActiveCampaign leans lead-management, inbound-sales; Beehiiv leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Beehiiv is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: ActiveCampaign is Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+; contact-based pricing.; Beehiiv is Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referrals, and audience tools — adjacent to classic ESPs..
- Workflow coverage skew: ActiveCampaign-leaning lead-management, inbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs Beehiiv-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: ActiveCampaign — Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Beehiiv — Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP.

Limitations — ActiveCampaign: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Beehiiv: Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP; Automation depth trails ActiveCampaign-class ESPs.

Poor-fit cases: ActiveCampaign is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change. · Beehiiv is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP · Avoid ActiveCampaign if you actually need Beehiiv's motion (Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referrals, and aud)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
